2.name: Pewter City
2._comment: Doors are the map's warp table (read back from wWarpEntries): Gym (16,17)->54, Pokemon Center (13,25)->58, Mart (23,17)->56, Museum (14,7)/(19,5)->52. The old first waypoint (13,25) 'Enter from forest' WAS the Pokemon Center door — every lane walked in and wedged at the counter (evals/cases/pewter-pokecenter-exit.json) — and the old 'Pewter Gym' waypoint (16,11) is open ground north of the building. Layout (emulator BFS from the Route 2 entry): a fence spans y=21 for x<=18 with the gap at x>=19; the Gym block (x 12-17, y 14-17) is fenced on its east side (x=18, y 18-21), so its door is reached from the west: north up x=19, west along y=13, south down x=10, east along y=18.
